title: Independent excited-state test of the BQ1–BQ7 photophysical series
difficulty_reasons: Seven related molecules require linked S0/S1/T1/T2 calculations, SOC and rate analysis.
The evaluated agent must reproduce a specified multistage author protocol, validate state/root mapping and rate inputs, and compare heavy-atom trends without silently substituting proxy methods.

data.description: Self-contained BQ1–BQ7 connectivity, formulas, charge, multiplicities and solvent boundary.

required_deliverables.description: Validated per-member excited-state observables, provenance, comparison and conclusion.
